Big clear margins on ALL edges of each cell, ensure no limb or tail crosses any boundary. Same camera elevation, lighting and anatomy across all cells. Painted 2.5D tabletop art. Exact same bald blue-grey ghoul with long pointed ears, pink tongue, ivory eyes, long clawed arms and bare feet, beige wrapped forearms and calves and ragged tan loincloth. No accessories. Subject faces upper left, REAR three-quarter matching the rear gameplay reference, show back and side. Ground crawl on hands and knees, seen from behind and left. Low torso and head, elbow bending, alternating opposite hand and knee contact in each half. Front pair of claws alternately touch and pull. Knees skim the same support line. Show all feet and all reaching claws with large lateral margins. No rear limbs from other cells.
